paragraphs: We are a leading public safety technology company that combines data-driven solutions and strategic advisory services for law enforcement, security teams and civic leadership. As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 319 customers and to date have worked with approximately 2,100 agencies to help drive more efficient, effective, and equitable public safety outcomes.

Our SafetySmartTM platform includes six data-driven tools consisting of: (i) our flagship product, ShotSpotter®, the leading outdoor gunshot detection, location and alerting system trusted by 178 cities and 22 universities and corporations as of December 31, 2025; (ii) CrimeTracerTM, an agency-wide crime data and intelligence platform that enables investigators, analysts, patrol officers and command staff to search through more than one billion criminal justice records from across jurisdictions, leverage dashboards and AI-assisted tools to generate tactical leads and quickly make intelligent connections to solve cases; (iii) CaseBuilderTM, a one-stop investigative case management system for tracking, reporting and collaborating on cases; (iv) ResourceRouterTM, which directs the deployment of patrol and community anti-violence resources in an objective way to help maximize the impact of limited resources and improve community safety; (v) PlateRangerTM powered by Rekor®, an automatic license plate recognition ("ALPR") and vehicle identification solution that leverages artificial intelligence ("AI") and machine learning to enhance investigative efficiency and provide real-time data sharing for law enforcement; and (vi) SafePointeTM, an AI-based weapons detection system designed to provide discreet, high-throughput screening that complements physical security measures without compromising visitor experience. These solutions may operate independently or together as an integrated system that connects detection, data analysis, resource deployment and case management workflows. We also offer other use-case specific solutions including ShotSpotter for Campus and ShotSpotter for Corporate, which are typically smaller-scale deployments of ShotSpotter gunshot detection vertically marketed to universities, corporate campuses and key infrastructure centers to mitigate risk and enhance security by notifying authorities of outdoor gunfire incidents, saving critical minutes for first responders to arrive. We offer the majority of our solutions on a software-as-a-service subscription model to our customers. In the first quarter of 2025, we rolled out a perimeter-based sniper gunshot detection solution targeting utility substations, with initial pilots aimed at utility customers, conducted through SoundThinking Labs. SoundThinking Labs supports innovative use cases of the Company's technology.

As of December 31, 2025, we had ShotSpotter, ShotSpotter for Campus and ShotSpotter for Corporate coverage areas under contract for over 1,092 square miles, of which over 1,064 square miles had gone live. Coverage areas under contract included 178 cities and 22 universities and corporations across the United States, South Africa, Uruguay, Brazil and the Bahamas, including some of the largest cities in the United States. Most of our revenue is attributable to customers based in the United States. Since our founding over 29 years ago, SoundThinking has been and continues to be a purpose-led company. We are a mission-driven organization that is focused on improving public safety outcomes. We accomplish this by earning the trust of law enforcement and providing solutions to help them better engage and strengthen the police-community relationships in fulfilling their sworn obligation to serve and protect all. Our inspiration comes from our principal founder, Dr. Bob Showen, who believes that the highest and best use of technology is to promote social good. We are committed to developing comprehensive, respectful and engaged partnerships with law enforcement agencies, elected officials and communities focused on making a positive difference in the world.

Local police departments are challenged to serve and protect in an increasingly transparent fashion without unintentionally over-policing and under serving their communities. This mandate must be met while facing municipal budget pressures, evolving public safety policies, and calls for police reform, all while violent crime remains a critical concern and case closure rates struggle to improve. There are three distinct problems associated with the public safety gap, which are discussed below.

We believe the majority of urban gunfire goes unreported. A 2016 report published by the Brookings Institution analyzing data collected from ShotSpotter and our customers suggests that approximately 80% of the gunshots detected by our public safety solution are not reported to 911 by residents. Even in the instances when 911 calls are made, the information reported by the caller is often incomplete or inaccurate as to the time and location of the gunshot. Furthermore, in many cases it is often difficult for the caller to authenticate the incident as gunfire. In addition, we believe that in communities plagued by gun violence, there is often a lack of trust between the community's residents and its police force, which can exacerbate the underreporting of gunfire and create a vicious cycle of underreporting, lack of response and increased mistrust due to continued unaddressed gun violence in the community. When gunfire is not reported or is reported inaccurately, law enforcement and medical personnel cannot address injuries nor effectively investigate and solve related crimes or prevent future incidents.

We also believe the communities in which gun violence occurs suffer significant economic loss. A 2017 report by the Urban Institute, which studied the effect of gun violence in Minneapolis, Minnesota, Oakland, California and Washington, D.C., noted that the perceived risk of gun violence imposed heavy social, psychological and monetary damages in communities, including fewer jobs and lower economic vitality. The study concluded:
 In Minneapolis, each additional gun homicide in a given year was statistically correlated with 80 fewer jobs.
 In Oakland, every additional gun homicide in a given year was statistically associated with five fewer job opportunities in contracting businesses in the next year.
 In Washington, D.C., every additional gun homicide in a given year was statistically associated with two fewer retail and service establishments the next year.

In addition, several studies have suggested that property values are inversely correlated with violent crime. For example, the Center for American Progress conducted a study of changes in homicide incidents and housing prices in Boston, Seattle, Chicago, Philadelphia and Milwaukee, and found that a reduction in a given year of one homicide in a ZIP code caused a 1.5% increase in housing values in that same ZIP code the following year.

Agencies face a resource deficit and need more efficient ways to patrol and prevent crime. Most departments use old patrolling methods that are not data-driven, have limited visibility to officer activity and no controls to reduce over-policing. We believe the category is ripe for AI-based automation for more efficient and effective patrolling done in a way that better engages the community and supports more effective, data-informed deployment of resources.

According to a report published by The Marshall Project in 2022, homicide clearance rates in the United States reached a 40-year low of less than 50% in 2021. While clearance rates have shown signs of improvement in more recent years (2023–2024), they remain below levels observed in prior decades and vary significantly across jurisdictions. Too many suspects do not face the consequences and are free to commit additional crimes while victims and their families suffer without closure. Police use a mix of manual, homegrown and limited function record management system ("RMS") modules for case management. To solve cases, detectives must access multiple, siloed sources of data with limited automation tools for analytical support or collaboration. We believe investigative case management can significantly benefit from greater automation to improve clearance rates and solves cases faster.

We see a world where data are converted into actionable intelligence thereby enabling law enforcement and security departments to implement practices to more efficiently direct interventions toward the relative few that commit crimes and present security threats. These practices in turn help build community trust and engagement while co-producing positive public safety outcomes. We believe the SafetySmart platform can be a valuable set of technological solutions for implementing these public safety practices. The SafetySmart platform includes our flagship product ShotSpotter, CrimeTracer, CaseBuilder, ResourceRouter, PlateRanger powered by Rekor and SafePointe, our AI-based weapons detection system.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
Our success depends on maintaining and increasing our sales, which depends in part on factors we cannot control, including the availability of funding to our customers.
Our quarterly results of operations may fluctuate significantly due to a wide range of factors, which makes our future results difficult to predict.

Because we generally recognize our subscription revenues ratably over the term of our contract with a customer, fluctuations in sales will not be fully reflected in our operating results until future periods.
We have not been profitable in the past and may not achieve or maintain profitability in the future.
Contracting with government entities can be complex, expensive, and time-consuming.
Our sales cycle can be lengthy, time-consuming and costly, and our inability to successfully complete sales could harm our business.
Concerns regarding privacy and government-sponsored surveillance may deter customers from purchasing our solutions.
The nature of our business may result in undesirable press coverage or other negative publicity, which could adversely affect our growth prospects and results of operations.

Economic uncertainties or downturns, or political changes, could limit the availability of funds available to our existing and potential customers, which could materially and adversely affect our business.
Ongoing social unrest may have a material adverse effect on our business, the future magnitude or duration of which we cannot predict with accuracy.
Natural disasters, infectious disease outbreaks, power outages and other events outside of our control may impact us or our customers and harm our operating results and financial condition.
The incurrence of debt may impact our financial position and subject us to additional financial and operating restrictions.
The competitive landscape for our security solutions is evolving and new competitors may enter the market for our public safety solutions.
The nature of our business exposes us to inherent liability risks.
If we fail to offer high-quality customer support, our business and reputation may suffer.
We rely on a limited number of suppliers and contract manufacturers, and our proprietary ShotSpotter sensors are manufactured by a single contract manufacturer.
We are dependent on the continued services and performance of our senior management and other key personnel, the loss of any of whom could adversely affect our business.
If we are unable to attract, integrate and retain additional qualified personnel, including top technical talent, our business could be adversely affected.
Our ability to use our net operating losses to offset future taxable income may be subject to certain limitations.
Risks Related to Our Growth Strategy
If we are unable to reach additional public safety customers, expand into new markets or cross-sell our other solutions to our existing customers, our revenues may not grow.
If our business does not grow as we expect, or if we fail to manage our growth effectively, our operating results and business prospects would suffer.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should consider carefully the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this report, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before deciding whether to purchase shares of our common stock. If any of the following risks is realized, our business, operating results, financial condition and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment. Moreover, the risks described below are not the only ones that we face. Additional risks not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also affect our business, operating results, prospects or financial condition. You should carefully consider these risk factors, together with all of the other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K as well as our other publicly available filings with the SEC.

To date, substantially all of our revenues have been derived from contracts with local governments and their agencies, in particular the police departments of major cities in the United States. To a lesser extent, we also generate revenues from federal agencies, foreign governments and higher education institutions. We believe that the success and growth of our business will continue to depend on our ability to maintain existing contracts with government agencies and to add new police departments and other government agencies, domestically and internationally, as customers of our public safety solutions and new universities, corporate campuses, hospitals, casinos and key infrastructure and transportation centers as customers of our security solutions. In order to maintain and add customers, we must protect our brand and reputation, including as a result of negative publicity, and address any public concerns

or perceptions regarding privacy and surveillance. See "Real or perceived false positive gunshot alerts or false positive security threat detection, or failure or perceived failure to generate alerts for actual gunfire or missed weapon detection could adversely affect our customers and their operations, damage our brand and reputation and adversely affect our growth prospects and results of operations," "The nature of our business may result in undesirable press coverage or other negative publicity, which could adversely affect our growth prospects and results of operations," and "Concerns regarding privacy and government-sponsored surveillance may deter customers from purchasing our solutions."

In addition, many of our target customers have restricted budgets, such that we are forced to compete with programs or solutions that offer an alternative use of the same funds. Many factors outside of our control could cause current and/or potential customers to delay or refrain from purchasing our solutions, prevent expansion of, or reduce coverage areas and/or terminate use of our solutions, including:
• decreases or changes in available funding, tax revenues, budgetary allocations, government grants and other government funding programs;
• potential delays or changes in appropriations or other funding authorization processes; • changes in fiscal or contracting policies;

We are a leading public safety technology company that combines data-driven solutions and strategic advisory services for law enforcement, security teams and civic leadership. In April 2023, we changed the company name, ShotSpotter, Inc., to SoundThinking, Inc., reflecting our broader impact on public safety through a growing set of industry-leading law enforcement tools and community-focused solutions. As part of the rebranding, we introduced the SafetySmartTM platform that includes six data-driven tools consisting of: (i) our flagship product, ShotSpotter®, our leading outdoor gunshot detection, location and alerting system trusted by 178 cities and 22 universities and corporations as of December 31, 2025; (ii) CrimeTracerTM, an agency-wide crime data and intelligence platform that enables investigators, analysts, patrol officers and command staff to search through more than one billion criminal justice records from across jurisdictions, leverage dashboards and AI-assisted tools to generate tactical leads, and quickly make intelligent connections to solve cases; (iii) CaseBuilderTM, a one-stop investigative case management system for tracking, reporting, and collaborating on cases; (iv) ResourceRouterTM, which directs the deployment of patrol and community anti-violence resources in an objective way to help maximize the impact of limited resources and improve community safety; (v) PlateRangerTM powered by Rekor®, an ALPR and vehicle identification solution that leverages AI and machine learning to enhance investigative efficiency and provide real-time data sharing for law enforcement and (vi) SafePointeTM, an AI-based weapons detection system designed to provide discreet, high-throughput screening that complements physical security measures without compromising visitor experience. These solutions may operate independently or together as an integrated system that connects detection, data analysis, resource deployment and case management workflows. We also offer other security use-case specific solutions, including ShotSpotter for Campus and ShotSpotter for Corporate, which are typically smaller-scale deployments of ShotSpotter gunshot detection vertically marketed to universities, corporate campuses and key infrastructure centers to mitigate risk and enhance security by notifying authorities of outdoor gunfire incidents, saving critical minutes for first responders to arrive. In the first quarter of 2025, we rolled out a perimeter-based sniper gunshot detection solution targeting utility substations, with initial pilots aimed at utility customers, conducted through SoundThinking Labs. SoundThinking Labs supports innovative use cases of the Company's technology to help protect wildlife and the environment.

Our gunshot detection solutions consist of highly-specialized, cloud-based software integrated with proprietary, internet-enabled sensors designed to detect outdoor gunfire. The speed and accuracy of our gunfire alerts enable law enforcement and security personnel to consistently and quickly respond to shooting events including those unreported through 911, which can increase the chances of apprehending the shooter, providing timely aid to victims, and identifying witnesses before they scatter, as well as aid in evidence collection and serve as an overall deterrent. When a potential gunfire incident is detected by our sensors, our system precisely locates where the incident occurred and applies machine classification combined with human review to analyze and validate the incident. An alert containing a location on a map and critical information about the incident is sent directly to subscribing law enforcement or security personnel through any internet-connected computer and to iPhone or Android mobile devices.

Our software sends gunfire data along with the audio of the triggering sound to our Incident Review Center ("IRC"), where our trained incident review specialists are on duty 24 hours a day, seven days a week, 365 days a year to screen and confirm actual gunfire incidents. Our trained incident review specialists can supplement alerts with additional tactical information, such as the potential presence of multiple shooters or the use of high-capacity weapons. Gunshot incidents reviewed by our IRC result in alerts typically sent within approximately 45 seconds of the receipt of the gunfire incident.

We offer our solutions on a software-as-a-service subscription model to our customers. We generate annual subscription revenues from the deployment of ShotSpotter on a per-square-mile basis. Our security solutions, ShotSpotter for Campus and ShotSpotter for Corporate are typically sold on a subscription basis, each with a

customized deployment plan. Our ResourceRouter solution, CaseBuilder, PlateRanger and CrimeTracer are also sold on a subscription basis generally customized based on the number of sworn officers in a particular city. We generate annual subscription revenues from the deployment of SafePointe on a per-lane basis, a lane being the detection area between two lanes. As of December 31, 2025, we had ShotSpotter, ShotSpotter for Campus, and ShotSpotter for Corporate coverage areas under contract for over 1,092 square miles, of which over 1,064 square miles had gone live. Coverage areas under contract for ShotSpotter included 178 cities and coverage areas under contract for ShotSpotter for Campus and ShotSpotter for Corporate included 22 campuses/sites across the United States, South Africa, Brazil, Uruguay and the Bahamas, including some of the largest cities in the United States. As of December 31, 2025, we had 291 SafePointe lanes under contract. Most of our revenues are attributable to customers based in the United States.

While we intend to continue to devote resources to increase sales of our solutions, we expect that revenues from ShotSpotter will continue to comprise a majority of our revenues for the foreseeable future. SoundThinking Labs projects are generally conducted in coordination with a sponsoring charitable organization and may or may not be revenue-producing. When they are revenue-producing, they will generally be sold on a cost-plus basis. As such, SoundThinking Labs projects will normally produce gross margins significantly lower than most of our other solutions. Additionally, in early 2021, we added new pricing programs for Tier 4 and 5 law enforcement agencies (those with fewer than 100 sworn officers) that allow them to contract for our gunshot detection solutions to cover a footprint of less than three square miles, using standardized coverage parameters, at a discounted annual subscription rate.

We acquired LEEDS, LLC ("LEEDS") in November 2020 to expand our suite of solutions and introduce CaseBuilder. CaseBuilder is our case management solution that helps automate investigative work and improve case clearance rates – addressing an inefficiency problem for many agencies that have had to rely on multiple disparate systems to work cases. Using the software, investigators benefit from a single digital case folder that includes all elements related to a case. Analytical and collaboration tools help investigators connect the dots and share information faster while reporting helps package cases for command staff and prosecutors. In May 2023, we renamed LEEDS to Technologic Solutions, LLC ("Technologic").

In January 2022, we acquired Forensic Logic, a leading provider of cloud-based data services to U.S. law enforcement and public safety to enable powering the industry's most advanced search and analysis technology. We believe combining lead generation from Forensic Logic with our CaseBuilder case management solution, and utilizing CrimeTracer, can accelerate crime solving solutions and improve clearance rates.
In August 2023, we acquired SafePointe, a provider of an AI-driven next-generation concealed weapons detection solution and added this technology to our SafetySmart platform.

In July 2024, we announced a strategic partnership to create and launch a new end-to-end vehicle and ALPR public safety solution, "PlateRanger, Powered by Rekor." This collaboration combines SoundThinking's expertise in acoustic gunshot detection and investigative solutions with Rekor's vehicle ALPR solutions.

Since our founding over 29 years ago, SoundThinking has been and continues to be a purpose-led company. We are a mission-driven organization that focuses on improving public safety outcomes. We accomplish this by earning the trust of law enforcement and providing solutions to help them better engage and strengthen the police-community relationships in fulfilling their sworn obligation to serve and protect all. Our inspiration comes from our principal founder, Dr. Bob Showen, who believes that the highest and best use of technology is to promote social good. We are committed to developing comprehensive, respectful, and engaged partnerships with law enforcement agencies, elected officials and communities focused on making a positive difference in the world.

paragraphs: 本公司為一領導的公共安全科技公司，結合數據驅動解決方案與戰略諮詢服務，服務警務單位、安全團隊與市民領導層。截至2025年12月31日，本公司約有319個客戶，至今已與約2,100個機構合作，協助推動更有效率、更有效果且更公平的公共安全成果。

我們的SafetySmartTM平台包含六種數據驅動工具，包括：(i) 我們的旗艦產品ShotSpotter®，為一領導的戶外槍聲偵測、定位與警示系統，截至2025年12月31日，已被178個城市與22所大學及企業機構信任使用；(ii) CrimeTracerTM，為一機構範圍的犯罪資料與情報平台，使調查員、分析師、巡邏員與指揮人員能搜尋來自不同管轄區域超過十億筆的司法記錄，運用看板與AI輔助工具產生戰術線索，並迅速做出智能連結以解決案件；(iii) CaseBuilderTM，為一整合性的調查案件管理系統，用以追蹤、報告與協同處理案件；(iv) ResourceRouterTM，用以客觀地部署巡邏與社區反暴力資源，協助最大化有限資源的影響力，並提升社區安全；(v) PlateRangerTM 由Rekor®驅動，為一自動車牌辨識（"ALPR"）與車輛辨識解決方案，運用人工智慧（"AI"）與機器學習以提升調查效率，並提供執法單位即時資料共享；(vi) SafePointeTM，為一基於AI的武器偵測系統，設計用以提供隱蔽、高吞吐量的篩檢，補強實體安全措施而不影響訪客體驗。這些解決方案可獨立運作或共同作為整合系統，連接偵測、資料分析、資源部署與案件管理流程。本公司亦提供其他特定應用場景的解決方案，包括ShotSpotter for Campus與ShotSpotter for Corporate，這些通常是較小規模的ShotSpotter槍聲偵測部署，專門行銷至大學、企業校區與關鍵基礎設施中心，以降低風險並提升安全，透過通知執法單位戶外槍聲事件，為第一應變單位節省關鍵分鐘。本公司將大多數解決方案以軟體即服務（SaaS）訂閱模式提供給客戶。在2025年第一季，本公司推出一項基於周界防衛的狙擊槍聲偵測解決方案，目標為電力變電站，初期試點針對電力客戶進行，透過SoundThinking Labs執行。SoundThinking Labs支援本公司技術的創新應用場景。

截至2025年12月31日，本公司與ShotSpotter、ShotSpotter for Campus與ShotSpotter for Corporate的覆蓋區域簽約總計超過1,092平方英里，其中超過1,064平方英里已啟用。簽約的覆蓋區域包括美國、南非、烏拉圭、巴西與巴哈馬的178個城市與22所大學及企業機構，包含美國的一些最大城市。本公司大多數收入來自美國的客戶。自本公司成立以來超過29年，SoundThinking一直以來並持續為一以使命為導向的公司。本公司為一以使命為導向的組織，專注於改善公共安全成果。我們透過獲得執法單位的信任並提供解決方案，協助他們更好地與社區互動，強化警民關係，以履行其誓言服務與保護所有人的義務。我們的靈感來自我們的主要創辦人Dr. Bob Showen，他認為科技的最高與最佳用途是促進社會福祉。我們致力於與執法單位、選舉官員與社區建立全面、尊重且參與的夥伴關係，以對世界產生正面影響。
地方警察部門面臨在日益透明的環境中服務與保護的挑戰，而無意過度執法並忽略服務社區。此任務必須在面對市府預算壓力、演進中的公共安全政策與警察改革呼聲的同時達成，而暴力犯罪仍是關鍵關注點，且案件結案率仍難以改善。與公共安全缺口相關的三個獨特問題，如下所述。

我們認為大多數都市槍聲未被報告。2016年由布魯金斯研究所發表的一份報告，分析來自ShotSpotter與我們客戶的資料，顯示約80%被我們公共安全解決方案偵測到的槍聲未被居民報警至911。即使在有911通報的情況下，通報者提供的資訊往往不完整或不準確，關於槍聲的時間與地點。此外，在許多情況下，通報者難以確認事件為槍聲。此外，我們認為在槍支暴力盛行的社區，社區居民與警方之間往往缺乏信任，這會加劇槍聲未被報告的情況，並形成報告不足、回應不足與增加不信任的惡性循環，因社區持續未處理的槍支暴力。當槍聲未被報告或報告不準確時，執法單位與醫療人員無法處理傷害，亦無法有效調查與解決相關犯罪，或預防未來事件。
我們也認為發生槍支暴力的社區遭受顯著的經濟損失。2017年由都市研究所發表的一份報告，研究槍支暴力在明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯、加利福尼亞州奧克蘭與華盛頓特區的影響，指出槍支暴力的感知風險對社區造成沉重的社會、心理與經濟損失，包括較少的工作機會與較低的經濟活力。該研究結論為：
 在明尼阿波利斯，每年每增加一宗槍支謀殺案，統計上與80個較少的工作機會相關。
 在奧克蘭，每年每增加一宗槍支謀殺案，統計上與下一年度 contracting 企業的五個較少的工作機會相關。
 在華盛頓特區，每年每增加一宗槍支兇殺案，統計上會與隔年零售及服務業 establishments 數量減少兩家有關。
此外，幾項研究指出，財產價值與暴力犯罪呈負相關。例如，美國進步中心（Center for American Progress）針對波士頓、西雅圖、芝加哥、費城與密爾沃基的兇殺案數量變動與住宅價格進行研究，並發現某 ZIP 碼在某年減少一宗兇殺案，會導致該 ZIP 碼隔年住宅價值增加 1.5%。
機構面臨資源缺口，需要更有效率的方式進行巡邏與預防犯罪。大多數部門使用過時的巡邏方法，缺乏數據驅動，對警員活動的可見度有限，且沒有控制措施來減少過度執法。我們認為此領域適合 AI 基礎的自動化，以實現更有效率且有效的巡邏方式，同時更好地與社區互動，並支持更有效率、基於數據的資源部署。

根據馬歇爾計畫（The Marshall Project）於 2022 年發表的報告，美國的兇殺案解決率在 2021 年達到 40 年來的低點，低於 50%。雖然近年（2023–2024 年）解決率顯示出改善跡象，但仍然低於過去十年的水平，且在不同管轄區域間有顯著差異。過多嫌疑犯未受到應有後果，自由繼續犯罪，而受害者及其家屬則無 closure。警方使用混合的手動、自製且功能有限的記錄管理系統（"RMS"）模組進行案件管理。為解決案件，偵探必須存取多個、孤立的數據來源，且缺乏自動化工具以提供分析支援或協作。我們認為調查案件管理可從更大程度的自動化中受益，以提高解決率並更快解決案件。

我們看到一個世界，數據被轉換為可操作的智慧，從而使執法與安全部門能實施做法，更有效率地將幹擾導向少數犯罪及安全威脅者。這些做法同時有助於建立社區信任與參與，並共同產生正面的公共安全成果。我們認為 SafetySmart 平台可成為實現這些公共安全做法的技術解決方案組合。SafetySmart 平台包含我們的旗艦產品 ShotSpotter、CrimeTracer、CaseBuilder、ResourceRouter、PlateRanger powered by Rekor 以及 SafePointe，我們的 AI 基礎武器偵測系統。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況與營運成果之分析，並與本年度10-K財務報導所附之合併財務報表及其附註一併參考。

我們是一家領先的公共安全科技公司，結合數據驅動解決方案與戰略諮詢服務，服務警政、安全團隊與地方領導層。2023年4月，我們將公司名稱從ShotSpotter, Inc. 更改為SoundThinking, Inc.，反映我們透過日益增多的行業領導級警用工具與社區導向解決方案，對公共安全產生更廣泛的影響。作為品牌重塑的一部分，我們推出了SafetySmartTM平台，包含六項數據驅動工具，包括：(i) 我們的旗艦產品ShotSpotter®，為一項受178個城市與22所大學及企業委託使用的戶外槍聲偵測、定位與警報系統，截至2025年12月31日；(ii) CrimeTracerTM，為一項跨管轄區域的犯罪資料與情報平台，使調查人員、分析師、巡邏警員與指揮人員得以搜尋超過十億筆刑事司法紀錄，運用看板與AI輔助工具產生戰術線索，並迅速做出智能連結以解決案件；(iii) CaseBuilderTM，為一項整合式調查案件管理系統，用以追蹤、報告與協同處理案件；(iv) ResourceRouterTM，用以客觀導向部署巡邏與社區反暴力資源，以協助最大化有限資源的影響力並提升社區安全；(v) PlateRangerTM 由 Rekor® 驅動，為一項ALPR與車輛識別解決方案，運用AI與機器學習提升調查效率並提供執法部門即時資料共享；(vi) SafePointeTM，為一項基於AI的武器偵測系統，設計用以提供隱蔽、高吞吐量的篩檢，補強實體安全措施而不影響訪客體驗。這些解決方案可獨立運作，或作為整合系統運作，連接偵測、資料分析、資源部署與案件管理流程。我們也提供其他特定安全用途的解決方案，包括ShotSpotter for Campus與ShotSpotter for Corporate，通常為較小規模的ShotSpotter槍聲偵測部署，針對大學、企業校區與關鍵基礎設施中心進行垂直行銷，以降低風險並提升安全，透過通知執法部門戶外槍聲事件，為第一應變單位節省關鍵分鐘。2025年第一季，我們推出了一項以周界為基礎的狙擊槍聲偵測解決方案，目標為電力變電站，初期試點針對電力客戶進行，透過SoundThinking Labs進行。SoundThinking Labs支持本公司技術的創新應用案例，以協助保護野生動物與環境。

我們的槍聲偵測解決方案由高度專業化的雲端軟體組成，與專利的網際網路啟動感測器整合，用以偵測戶外槍聲。我們槍聲警報的速度與準確性使執法與安全人員能持續且迅速回應槍聲事件，包括那些未經911通報的事件，這可提高逮捕槍手的機率、提供受害者及時援助、在證人散佈前識別證人，以及協助證據收集並作為整體威懾措施。當我們的感測器偵測到潛在槍聲事件時，系統會精確定位事件發生地點，並結合機器分類與人工審查分析與驗證事件。包含地圖上位置與事件關鍵資訊的警報會直接傳送至訂閱的執法或安全人員，透過任何網際網路連線的電腦，以及iPhone或Android行動裝置。
我們的軟體會將槍聲資料與觸發聲音的音訊傳送至我們的事件審查中心（"IRC"），在該中心，我們訓練有素的事件審查專員24小時、全年無休地值班，以篩選並確認實際槍聲事件。我們訓練有素的事件審查專員可補充警報資訊，例如可能有多名槍手或使用高容量武器的潛在情況。經我們IRC審查的槍聲事件通常在接收槍聲事件後約45秒內傳送警報。
我們以軟體即服務（SaaS）訂閱模式向客戶提供解決方案。我們從ShotSpotter的每平方英里部署產生年度訂閱收入。我們的安全解決方案ShotSpotter for Campus與ShotSpotter for Corporate通常以訂閱模式銷售，每種方案均有

客製化部署計畫。我們的ResourceRouter解決方案、CaseBuilder、PlateRanger與CrimeTracer也通常以訂閱模式銷售，一般根據特定城市警員人數進行客製化。我們從SafePointe的部署產生年度訂閱收入，每條車道（lane）為兩條車道之間的偵測區域。截至2025年12月31日，我們有ShotSpotter、ShotSpotter for Campus與ShotSpotter for Corporate的覆蓋區域在合約中，總計超過1,092平方英里，其中超過1,064平方英里已啟用。ShotSpotter的覆蓋區域合約包括178個城市，而ShotSpotter for Campus與ShotSpotter for Corporate的覆蓋區域合約包括美國、南非、巴西、烏拉圭與巴哈馬的22個校區/場地，包括美國的一些最大城市。截至2025年12月31日，我們有291條SafePointe車道在合約中。我們的大部分收入來自美國的客戶。

雖然我們有意繼續投入資源以增加解決方案的銷售，但我們預期ShotSpotter的收入將在可預見的未來繼續佔我們收入的大多數。SoundThinking Labs的專案通常與贊助的慈善組織協調進行，可能產生收入，也可能不產生收入。當產生收入時，通常以成本加成方式銷售。因此，SoundThinking Labs的專案通常會產生顯著低於我們其他解決方案的毛利率。此外，在2021年初，我們為 Tier 4 和 Tier 5 警政機構（警員人數少於100人）新增了價格方案，讓他們以標準化覆蓋參數，以折扣年度訂閱費率，訂購我們的槍聲偵測解決方案，覆蓋面積小於三平方英里。

我們於2020年11月收購LEEDS, LLC（"LEEDS"），以擴展我們的解決方案組合並引入CaseBuilder。CaseBuilder為我們的案件管理解決方案，協助自動化調查工作並提高案件結案率，解決許多機構必須依賴多個分散系統處理案件的低效率問題。透過此軟體，調查人員可受益於一個數位案件資料夾，包含與案件相關的所有要素。分析與協同工具協助調查人員快速連接資訊並分享資料，而報告功能則協助將案件打包給指揮層與檢察官。2023年5月，我們將LEEDS更名為Technologic Solutions, LLC（"Technologic"）。
2022 年 1 月，本公司取得 Forensic Logic，為美國法務與公共安全領域提供基於雲端的資料服務之領導供應商，以啟動業界最進階之搜尋與分析技術。本公司認為，將 Forensic Logic 之潛在客戶生成能力與本公司 CaseBuilder 案件管理解決方案結合，並運用 CrimeTracer，可加速犯罪解決方案之發展，並提高破案率。
2023 年 8 月，本公司取得 SafePointe，為提供基於人工智慧之新一代隱藏武器偵測解決方案之供應商，並將此技術加入本公司 SafetySmart 平台。
2024 年 7 月，本公司宣佈與 Rekor 籤訂戰略合作夥伴關係，以開發並推出全新之車輛與 ALPR 公共安全解決方案，名為 "PlateRanger, Powered by Rekor." 此合作結合 SoundThinking 在聲學槍聲偵測與調查解決方案之專業知識，與 Rekor 之車輛 ALPR 解決方案。

自本公司成立以來超過 29 年，SoundThinking 一直都是並持續為一以使命為導向之公司。本公司為一以使命為導向之組織，專注於改善公共安全成果。本公司透過贏得法務部門之信任，並提供解決方案，協助他們更有效地與社區互動，強化警民關係，以履行其誓言之服務與保護所有民眾之義務。本公司之靈感來自本公司創辦人之一，Dr. Bob Showen，他認為科技之最高與最佳用途為促進社會福祉。本公司致力於與法務部門、選舉產生之公職人員及社區建立全面、尊重且積極參與之夥伴關係，以對世界產生正面影響。
本公司與客戶簽訂訂閱合約，通常為 1 到 3 年之期限。本公司幾乎所有銷售均為對政府機構與大學，這些機構往往進行漫長之契約評估程序，此程序會影響本公司銷售契約之規模或時程，並可能同時提高本公司客戶取得成本。

headings: 與我們業務及營運相關的風險
我們的成功取決於維持並增加銷售額，而這部分取決於我們無法控制的因素，包括客戶取得資金的可得性。
我們的季度營運結果可能因廣泛的因素而大幅波動，使我們未來的結果難以預測。
由於我們通常會根據與客戶的契約期間，按比例確認訂閱收入，因此銷售額的波動不會完全反映在營運結果中，直到未來期間。
我們過去未曾獲利，未來可能無法實現或維持獲利。
與政府機構簽訂契約可能複雜、昂貴且耗時。
我們的銷售週期可能長、耗時且成本高，若我們無法成功完成銷售，可能對我們的業務造成傷害。
關於隱私權及政府資助監視的擔憂，可能使客戶放棄購買我們的解決方案。
本公司業務性質可能導致不利的媒體報導或其他負面宣傳，可能對本公司成長潛力及營運成果造成不利影響。
總體經濟不確定性或衰退，或政治變動，可能限制現有及潛在客戶可取得資金的可得性，可能對本公司業務造成重大且不利的影響。
持續的社會動盪可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響，其未來影響程度或持續時間本公司無法準確預測。
天然災害、傳染病爆發、電力中斷及其他超出本公司控制範圍的事件，可能影響本公司或客戶，並損害本公司營運成果與財務狀況。
負債的產生可能影響本公司財務狀況，並使本公司面臨額外的財務與營運限制。
本公司安全解決方案的競爭環境正在演變，可能有新的競爭者進入本公司公共安全解決方案的市場。
本公司業務性質使本公司面臨內在的責任風險。
若本公司未能提供高品質的客戶支援服務，可能影響本公司業務與聲譽。
我們依賴有限數量的供應商與製造商，而我們的專利 ShotSpotter 零組件是由單一製造商製造。
我們依賴高階管理階層及其他關鍵人員的持續服務與表現，若失去任何一位，可能會對我們的業務造成不利影響。
若我們無法吸引、整合並留住更多合格的人員，包括頂尖技術人才，可能會對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們使用淨營業虧損來抵減未來應稅所得的能力，可能受到某些限制。
與我們成長策略相關的風險
若我們無法拓展更多公共安全客戶、進入新市場或向現有客戶交叉銷售其他解決方案，我們的營收可能不會成長。
若我們的業務成長不如預期，或我們未能有效管理成長，將會對我們的營運績效與業務前景造成不利影響。
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本報告中所有其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及其相關附註，以決定是否購買本公司普通股。若任何上述風險實現，將可能對本公司業務、營運結果、財務狀況與前景造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的價格可能下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。此外，下列所描述的風險並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險，目前我們尚未知悉或認為不重要，也可能影響本公司業務、營運結果、前景或財務狀況。您應仔細考慮這些風險因素，並配合本年度報告表10-K中所有其他資訊，以及本公司其他公開提交至證券交易委員會（SEC）的資料。

截至目前為止，本公司幾乎所有的營業收入均來自與地方政府及其機構的契約，特別是美國主要城市的警務部門。較少程度地，我們也從聯邦機構、外國政府及高等學府獲取收入。我們認為，本公司業務的成功與成長將持續取決於我們維持與政府機構現有契約的能力，以及在國內外增加新的警務部門及其他政府機構作為我們公共安全解決方案的客戶，以及增加新的大學、企業校區、醫院、賭場及關鍵基礎設施與交通中心作為我們安全解決方案的客戶。為維持並增加客戶，我們必須保護我們的品牌與聲譽，包括因負面報導所導致的影響，並處理任何有關隱私權與監視的公眾關注或觀感。

或有關隱私權與政府 sponsored 監視的關注，可能使客戶放棄購買我們的解決方案。請參閱「實際或被認為的槍聲警報錯誤或安全威脅偵測錯誤，或未能生成實際槍聲警報或漏掉武器偵測，可能對客戶及其營運造成不利影響，損害我們的品牌與聲譽，並對我們的成長前景與營運結果造成不利影響」、「本公司業務的性質可能導致不理想的媒體報導或其他負面報導，這可能對我們的成長前景與營運結果造成不利影響」，以及「有關隱私權與政府 sponsored 監視的關注可能使客戶放棄購買我們的解決方案」。
此外，許多我們目標客戶的預算受到限制，使得我們被迫與提供相同資金替代用途的方案或計畫競爭。許多因素超出我們的控制範圍，可能導致現有或潛在客戶延遲或放棄購買我們的解決方案，阻止擴展或減少覆蓋範圍，或終止使用我們的解決方案，包括：
• 可用資金、稅收收入、預算分配、政府補助金及其他政府資金計畫的減少或變更；
• 潛在的撥款或其它資金授權程序的延遲或變更；• 財政或採購政策的變更；
